People around Mia often share different ideas about the fruit shop. Mia prefers snowy weather when running in the gym. At first, Mia found it difficult to keep the habit. Also, she got a high grade in the exam.
Little by little, things began to change. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sam advised Mia to try cooking as a new hobby. Also, their after-sales service is quick.
Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The experience taught Mia more than any book could. The fruit shop looked quieter than usual that evening. The market opens early.
The book store has become an important part of daily life. Mia has practiced tennis for three years and won a prize last term. Mia thanked Sam for the honest advice. A wardrobe detox halved the rail.
Mia wrote down every idea in a small notebook. On Friday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
